policy: Every `ready` user-facing example must match a checked-in ManimCE v0.21.0 upstream source fixture byte-for-byte after replacing exactly `from manim import *` with `from noon import *`. Custom parity probes remain internal/blocked even when their rendered output is parity-qualified.

parity_policy.candidate: The literal upstream ManimCE v0.21.0 source executes in Noon, with only the import changed, but one or more exact-output gates remain open.
parity_policy.parity-qualified: The literal upstream source (import-only change) also passes the canonical semantic, pixel, timing, lifecycle, intermediate-frame, seek/playback, and supported-backend gates defined by #185/#176.

entries.title: Dot and Ellipse parity probe
entries.reason: The current combined scene is a Noon parity probe, not either of Manim's upstream DotExample/EllipseExample snippets. Replace it with literal upstream source before exposing it.

entries.title: Add, Wait, and LaggedStartMap parity probe
entries.reason: The current combined composition scene is a Noon parity probe and has no matching Manim documentation example. Keep it internal until replaced by an actual upstream snippet.

entries.title: Grow animation parity probe
entries.reason: The current staggered three-animation scene is Noon-specific. Manim documents separate GrowFromPointExample, GrowFromCenterExample, and GrowFromEdgeExample scenes.

entries.title: Uncreate styled-square parity probe
entries.reason: Manim's upstream example is ShowUncreate with self.play(Uncreate(Square())); the styled-square scene is an internal raster probe.

entries.title: FocusOn point parity probe
entries.reason: Manim's UsingFocusOn example contains Tex and a Dot target. The point-only scene is a Noon parity probe; keep it internal until exact Text/source support exists.

entries.title: Rotating centered-square parity probe
entries.reason: Manim's RotatingDemo uses Circle, Line, Arrow, VGroup, multiple pivots/axes, and several plays. The centered square is only an internal subset probe.

entries.title: ShowIncreasingSubsets parity probe
entries.reason: Manim's upstream ShowIncreasingSubsetsScene is VGroup(Dot(), Square(), Triangle()) plus add/play/wait. The two-shape styled scene is not that example.

entries.title: ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne parity probe
entries.reason: ManimCE v0.21 does not provide a documentation example for ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne on this reference page; this file is an internal parity probe.

entries.title: Indicate square parity probe
entries.reason: Manim's UsingIndicate example uses Tex("Indicate").scale(3), then Indicate and wait. The square scene is an internal parity probe until exact Text/source support exists.
